name: Regression: Non-destructive tagged layer updates prevent duplicate layer accumulation
description: Verify that repeatedly adjusting and rendering 2.5D Photometric lighting in-place updates the existing tagged layer rather than accumulating multiple duplicate layers (protects against name-sniffing regressions).

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode is filled, and draw a solid circular sprite in the center of the canvas
Click the 'Layers' tab in the right inspector panel
Verify exactly 1 layer exists in the layer stack (Base Layer)
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab in the right inspector panel
Switch to 'Manual' mode in the 2.5D Photometric Studio section
Select 'Gold / Brass' material and click 'Bake Light'
Verify the layer stack now contains exactly 2 layers (Base Layer and Photometric layer)
Return to the 'PixiBud AI' tab, change the Light Direction slider to a different angle, and click 'Bake Light' a second time
Verify the layer count strictly remains at exactly 2 layers, confirming the existing Photometric layer was updated in-place without creating duplicate layers
